name: Mash
source: Reference sheet generated 12 Nov 2026 from Jonny's picks (on his PC: codex-image-trial/out/mash-reference-sheet-2026-11-12.png; its measurements are the numbers here)
personality: Spud's everyday friend who never looks up (Jonny's pick, 12 Nov 2026). Tall, slouched, always on his phone; he misses what happens right in front of him, and that is what starts the trouble. Catchphrase, in gibberish with the same subtitle every time: "One sec."
voiceNote: gibberish (a proposal until Jonny has heard it)
notes: No hat, no weapon. One garment: the dark charcoal hoodie (costumes-everyday.js), hood DOWN so his shape and leaf show, a pouch pocket, two thin drawstrings. Big light-blue headphones round the neck. The phone is a prop a clip hands him (left hand on his sheet), not part of him. One leaf drooping to the side. Brown trousers, chunky white trainers. A tall narrow oval: his sheet draws him 1.43 of Spud's height, he is built about 1.35. Same skin, eyes and hands as Spud.
